verdict.rationale: Stable's own virtual-mailbox marketing says it can 'forward packages' and 'Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included,' which covers the forwarding part of the story only in thin marketing copy. Nothing addresses which carriers it accepts packages from, consolidation, or holding items for pickup. Missing for 10: evidence of acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hold-for-pickup, detailed forwarding docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
